english.title: Use a vehicle on a road without lights at night / in reduced visibility

(A)_[sunset and sunrise]_
(B)_[sunrise and sunset in seriously reduced visibility]_

when **(..SPECIFY THE FRONT / REAR POSITION / REAR REGISTRATION PLATE/ SIDE / END-OUTLINE MARKER LAMP(S)..) required to be fitted by the Road Vehicles Lighting Regulations 1989

english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 24(1)(a) of the Road Vehicles Lighting Regulations 1989, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in any other case.

Fixed penalty ticket - Fifty pounds.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
